home.title: Clear vision all day.
home.lead: Your child wears special lenses while they sleep. In the morning, they take them out and see clearly. Ortho-k may also help slow down nearsightedness as they grow.
home.introTitle: Is your child's prescription going up every year?
home.introLead: Nearsightedness often gets worse during the school years. Stronger glasses fix the blur, but they don't slow the change.
home.visitTitle: What happens at the first visit
home.visit1: We talk with you about your child's eyes and daily routine.
home.visit2: Your child has a full eye exam and a map of the front of the eye.
home.visit3: Dr. Woo explains the results and answers your questions.

about.title: Dr. Paul T. Woo, OD
about.lead: Dr. Woo is the founder and clinical director of 1234 Ortho-K Vision Care.
about.bio1: Dr. Woo graduated with a bachelor’s degree from University of California, Irvine and continued to get his Doctor of Optometry degree from Southern California College of Optometry.
about.bio2: As Orthokeratology evolved from day wear to night wear so did Dr. Woo. And now Dr. Woo is treating children who want to control their myopia from progressing and are able to see well all day by just wearing lenses when they sleep.
about.bio3: Former president of the San Gabriel Valley Optometric Association.
about.bio4: He wants to continue to work with other doctors to expand the acceptance and success of Orthokeratology.
about.staff: Our friendly, dedicated and highly trained staff is always happy to serve and help our patients through every step of the process.
